theme_and_archetype.description: A warm, organic dark mode mimicking rich soil. Dark shades of brown form the base, light green highlights interactive elements, and tan provides soft contrast for text and secondary accents.

headings.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none text-[#E8E4DB]

buttons.primary: bg-[#9EB27A] text-[#1C1614] font-medium hover:bg-[#B4C890] transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-full
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#CBA279] text-[#CBA279] hover:bg-[#CBA279] hover:text-[#1C1614] transition-colors px-6 py-3 rounded-full

forms.input: bg-[#1C1614] border border-[#433530] text-[#E8E4DB] rounded-lg px-4 py-3 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#9EB27A] focus:border-transparent
forms.label: text-sm font-medium text-[#A69A92] mb-2 block

Home.description: Overview dashboard for the solo beginner farmer.
features: Seasonal planting calendar with harvest time
Crop Recommendation (Top 3 with confidence % based on soil, NPK, pH, Temp)
AI Assistant Chatbot interface (Claude Sonnet 4.5 simulation)

Guide.description: Curated and private articles for learning.
features: Curated articles (Planting, Homemade fertilizer, Soil moisture, Disease/Pest control, Indigenous farming)
Private user-saved articles section (JWT auth needed for separation)

images.description: Serene farmland with barn and silo under a vibrant sunset sky.
Hands gently planting a young sprout in fresh soil.
Close-up of hands planting in a moist garden bed.
Close-up of a ladybird on a wheat spike under natural light outdoors.
Green leaves covered with holes from pests on summer day.

interactions_and_motion.hover_states: All cards should subtly lift (-translate-y-1) and increase border brightness on hover.
interactions_and_motion.transitions: Use transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out for interactive elements.
interactions_and_motion.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application strictly follows the Dark Earthy color palette. Do NOT use default black/white or generic Tailwind slate/gray colors.
The backgrounds must be #1C1614, and all cards/surfaces must be #2A221F with subtle #433530 borders.
Use Recharts for the interactive dashboard charts (NPK and pH levels).
Integrate Open-Meteo API for real-time weather trends on the Home page.
Implement browser GPS auto-detect for weather and location-based data.
The AI Assistant should be integrated as a chat interface on the Dashboard.
Setup JWT authentication so users can save private articles separately from main guide articles.
Apply `data-testid` to all actionable components (buttons, links, form inputs).
